title: Zero Single-Use Plastic Day
description: Go the whole day without accepting or using any single-use plastic cups, straws, or bags.

title: Meatless Green Day
description: Eat entirely plant-based meals today to significantly lower dietary carbon emissions.

title: Car-Free Day
description: Complete all your travel today strictly using walking, cycling, or public transport.

title: Neighborhood Litter Cleanup
description: Spend 15 minutes picking up and properly disposing of trash in your street or local park.

title: Digital Carbon Declutter
description: Delete unneeded cloud files, inbox spam, and duplicates to save data center energy.

title: Cold Water Laundry & Line Dry
description: Wash clothes using cold water and air dry them on a clothesline without using a dryer.

title: Community Tree Watering
description: Provide fresh water to at least 5 roadside trees or community garden plants.

title: Zero Food Waste Kitchen
description: Cook all meals from existing pantry ingredients and leftovers with zero edible waste.

title: Stair Climber Challenge
description: Skip the elevator all day and take the stairs for every floor you climb.

title: BYO Container Takeout
description: Bring your own lunchbox or container when picking up food or beverages.

title: Shop at Local Farmers Market
description: Purchase fresh seasonal vegetables or fruits from a local farmer or street vendor.

title: Vampire Power Shutdown
description: Unplug all chargers, monitors, microwaves, and power strips before going to sleep.

title: Urban Bird Water Station
description: Set up a clean shallow bowl of water and grains for urban birds on your balcony or roof.

title: 10 km Cycling Odyssey
description: Clock at least 10 kilometers of cycling in a single day for exercise and clean mobility.
